title: Dryden Wind Turbulence Model (Continuous (+q -r))
text: 使用 Dryden 速度谱生成连续风湍流，输入 3 路、输出 2 路；按 {Specification} 指定军用参考标准；{Units} 指定风速单位 Metric、{Model type} 指定湍流模型 Continuous Dryden、{Wind speed at 6 m defines the low altitude intensity} 指定实测风速、{Wind direction at 6 m (degrees clockwise from north)} 指定实测风向、{Probability of exceedance of high-altitude intensity} 指定湍流强度 10^-2、{Scale length at medium/high altitudes (m)} 指定湍流尺度长度、{Wingspan} 指定翼展、{Band limited noise sample time (seconds)} 指定噪声采样时间、{Random noise seeds} 指定噪声种子、{Turbulence on} 指定湍流信号，按实例取值。

params.name: Units
params.values: 风速单位 Metric (MKS) (default) | English (Velocity in ft/s) | English (Velocity in kts)

params.name: Specification
params.values: 军用参考标准 MIL-F-8785C (default) | MIL-HDBK-1797 | MIL-HDBK-1797B

params.name: Model type
params.values: 湍流模型 Continuous Dryden (+q -r) (default) | Continuous Von Karman (+q +r) | Continuous Von Karman (-q +r) | Continuous Von Karman (+q -r) | Continuous Dryden (+q +r) | Continuous Dryden (-q +r) | Discrete Dryden (+q -r) | Discrete Dryden (+q +r) | Discrete Dryden (-q +r)

params.name: Wind speed at 6 m defines the low altitude intensity
Wind direction at 6 m (degrees clockwise from north)
Probability of exceedance of high-altitude intensity
Scale length at medium/high altitudes (m)
params.values: 湍流尺度长度 533.4 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Band limited noise sample time (seconds)
params.values: 噪声采样时间 0.1 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Random noise seeds
params.values: 噪声种子 [ug vg wg pg] [23341 23342 23343 23344] (default) | four-element vector
